issue.title: Implement the approved ledger fee with exact spec-bound evidence
issue.body:
A fresh successful transfer now debits amount + 1 from the sender, credits amount to the recipient, and credits one unit to fee account 0. Identical accepted retries and rejected requests charge no fee. Fresh transfers involving account 0 are rejected.

The user approved the exact proposal published at 648229df2d0e13e8d872e0a867ab0ce940ea8146. The spec and lock bytes match the trusted base's approval record. Spec SHA-256: 2ad0742dcbf81bf24f9235ed88f9728c7b078dfa6ed55632a90b6aa847b35940. The candidate does not edit gate, policy, workflow, or approval code.

Validation completed locally: Dafny source gate; all 16 full-gate and Stage 1–3 regression commands; native incremental controls; exact approval rejection controls; TypeScript typecheck; ten behavior examples; 300 property runs and 4,131 model comparisons. A test-fixture typing failure and its repair are preserved. Local approved-change verification checked 4 obligations and reused 8; literal replay reproduced identical evidence.

This PR supplies the real Stage 4 approved-spec workflow demonstration. GitHub results must be inspected before acceptance. Source proof and finite TypeScript model comparisons remain separate; end_to_end=false. The compiled/deployed artifact chain is not proved.

issue.body:
Start from the approved fee implementation, then deliberately replace NonNegative with true and update the candidate spec digest. The trusted approval record stays unchanged.

Expected result: gate exit 1 with UNAPPROVED_PROTECTED_CHANGE, no accepted evidence, and a failed commit status. Human approval of the exact fee text must not authorize this later spec edit.

Do not merge this negative fixture. The approved fee spec remains unchanged on its implementation PR.
